correctness.rationale: The 16 open neighborhoods of K4 square K4 yield precisely 808 nonempty faces with f=(16,120,320,240,96,16). A fresh implementation independently built the 375 stagewise matching pairs, checked all 2736 oriented Hasse covers acyclic (58 critical cells), and reconstructed the 105-by-320 triangle relation matrix mod 2 with rank 104. The inspected verify.py defines the complete integral fundamental cycle lattice using the K16 star tree, displays a 104-by-104 determinant-one minor, a 105-by-105 determinant-minus-two minor and mod-2 rank 104: together these force Smith factors (1^104,2), H1=Z/2. The two-dimensional Morse CW model kills all H>=3; chi=56 and rank H1=0 give free H2 rank55. The determinantal certificate is an explicitly specified finite check, not a claim that mod-2 ranks alone determine integral torsion.
